title: Executive – IT Support
description:
**Company:** KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd.  
**Location:** Corporate Office, Edappally, Kochi  
**Department:** Information Technology (IT)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary**

KLM Axiva Finvest Ltd. is looking for a proactive and technically skilled Executive – IT Support to provide technical assistance to corporate office employees and branches. The role involves troubleshooting hardware and software issues, resolving branch-level technical complaints, guiding branch staff on hardware-related queries, and ensuring the smooth functioning of IT infrastructure across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to corporate office employees and branches for hardware, software, and system-related issues.
* Handle hardware-related queries from branches, clarify technical doubts, and guide branch staff in troubleshooting and resolving issues.
* Diagnose and resolve issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, biometric devices, and other IT peripherals.
* Coordinate with branches to identify technical problems and provide timely solutions through phone, remote support, or on-site visits when required.
* Arrange hardware repair, replacement, or vendor support for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computer systems, operating systems, and business applications.
* Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and other basic network-related issues.
* Coordinate with hardware vendors, service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure timely issue resolution.
* Maintain records of IT complaints, service requests, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions.
* Monitor IT assets and maintain accurate records of hardware inventory, allocation, and movement.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical complaints to minimize operational downtime and business disruption.
* Support IT infrastructure upgrades, new system installations, and other technology-related activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good knowledge of computer hardware, peripherals, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Basic understanding of networking, internet connectivity, and Windows operating systems.
* Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical branch employees.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple support requests and ensure timely closure.
* Willingness to coordinate with branches and travel for technical support when required.

**Experience**

Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may apply

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Service Desk Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:** ServiceDesk Coordinator (Helpdesk coordinator)

**Location:** Kochi

**Job Summary:**

The Service Desk Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day\-to\-day activities of the IT service desk or help desk team. They play a key role in ensuring that customer issues and technical support requests are addressed promptly and efficiently.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**Team Supervision:**

· Manage a team of service desk technicians or support staff.

· Provide guidance, coaching, and training to team members.

· Monitor team performance and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

**Ticket Management:**

· Receive, prioritize, and assign service requests and incidents to appropriate team members.

· Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all tickets.

· Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution and escalation as needed.

**Customer Support:**

· Act as the point of contact for customers and end\-users seeking technical assistance.

· Respond to customer inquiries and resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem\-solving.

**Process Improvement:**

· Identify opportunities to improve service desk processes and workflows.

· Implement best practices to enhance efficiency and customer service.

· Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Technical Knowledge:**

· Stay up\-to\-date with IT industry trends and technologies.

· Provide technical guidance and expertise to team members when needed.

· Assist with complex technical issues and escalations.

**Reporting and Metrics:**

· Generate reports on service desk performance, including ticket volumes, response times, and resolution rates.

· Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

· Prepare regular reports for management.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

· Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers.

· Assist in procurement and asset management activities as necessary.

**Security and Compliance:**

· Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures.

· Assist in incident response and security\-related tasks as required.

**General Responsibilities:**

· Maintain and update configuration documents.

· Maintain assets and software licenses/subscriptions.

· Vendor coordination and support

**Qualification:**

· Graduate or above

· 1\+ years of total experience

· ManageEngine service desk application (Optional)

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Familiarity with the ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) framework is a plus.

**Skills:**

· Handling any service desk ticketing tool.

· Ticket registration via Phone and email

· Logging and categorization of tickets

· Assign the engineers.

· Prepare and submit monthly reports.

· Maintain SLAs and do timely escalations.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

· Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately in English.

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience? ( 1\-2yrs)
* What is your current ctc?
* What is your Expected ctc?

Work Location: In person
